title: Design Tokens Document (DTCG)
description: A W3C Design Tokens (DTCG) document, as imported/exported by Penpot and Tokens Studio. Validates the structural shape: groups nest tokens, a token carries $value (+ optional $type/$description/$extensions). Lenient on $value by design - type-specific value checking lives in engine/src/tokens.js, not here.

$themes.description: Tokens-Studio themes: each selects + names a set of token sets.

$metadata.description: Document metadata. `tokenSetOrder` orders the top-level sets for layering.

$extensions.description: Document-level vendor data, never a token group: for example the brand system and its house rules at `com.suse.lolly.brandSystem` (engine/brand-system.md).
